blocks.md: This lesson follows **Three Machine Classes** in *The Causal Boundary* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, The Causal Boundary, § Three Machine Classes
blocks.md: As the warehouse mobile manipulator travels down an aisle, its primary engineering challenge is kinetic: preserving enough clearance to stop safely before an obstacle. When the same robot presses against a door latch, the governing constraint shifts to contact mechanics, regulating interaction forces to avoid damaging the mechanism or the workpiece. When holding a suspended payload stationary, the machine performs zero mechanical work, yet its actuators must sustain continuous stall torque without exhausting thermal headroom or browning out the shared electrical supply.
